'''The Falcon Stoops''' is a [[sword form]]. Other than the name, nothing is known about it. [[Gawyn Trakand]] used this form, as well as [[The Creeper Embraces the Oak]] and [[The Moon Rises Over the Lakes]], when he fought [[Aiel]] after the [[Battle of Dumai's Wells]].{{ref/book|7|p}}
